name: Composer
description:
Where the person writes. The text grows from one row to ten, then scrolls. Attachments and
context sit above it as chips; the toolbar below holds Attach, the workspace model (shown,
not chosen: it is set in AI settings), Context, dictation and the send circle, which turns
into Stop while a run is active. The conversation's status line can sit under the toolbar.

Material   the surface's (useCardMaterial): floating over a conversation it is
           glass-overlay, so the transcript scrolling behind it never shows through.

Keys   Enter sends · Shift+Enter new line · ↑ in an empty composer edits the last prompt ·
       Esc stops the run or closes a menu · / opens commands · @ mentions an entity.
Width  container-aware down to the docked pane: labels drop to icons, the model chip folds.
signature: ({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, onSend, onStop, onEditLast, run, placeholder, minRows, maxRows, context, onContextChange, model, onOpenSettings, attachments, onAttach, onRemoveAttachment, accept, commands, disabledReason, dictationPreview, autoFocus, size, status, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: ComposerProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted file types for Attach (GlassUxAiAttachmentConfiguration.SupportedFormats).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Attachments selected for the message.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the text on mount.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: commands
props.description: Available slash commands and their typed arguments.

props.name: context
props.description: The conversation's scope and references, as chips above the text.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: dictationPreview
props.description: Gallery: show the dictation state with this input level (0–1).

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Why nothing can be sent (budget used, provider unavailable). Keeps the box, disables it.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Rows before the composer scrolls.

props.name: minRows
props.description: Rows shown when empty (the landing composer uses 2).

props.name: model
props.description: The workspace's model: read-only here, set in AI settings.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Called with the files chosen in the file picker (filtered by `accept`). Supplying it shows the Attach button; add them to `attachments` to show them.

props.name: onContextChange
props.description: Called with the whole new context list when an entity is added (an

props.name: onEditLast
props.description: ↑ in an empty composer edits the last prompt.

props.name: onOpenSettings
props.description: Called from the AI settings button in the model popover; the button is shown only when this is supplied.

props.name: onRemoveAttachment
props.description: Called with the attachment `id` when the person removes its chip; the chip shows a remove button only when this is supplied.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the trimmed text; clear the composer by resolving.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the person stops a running response: the Stop button or Esc while `run` is `running` or `stopping` and no menu is open.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the full text on every edit, pick from a menu, dictation and the clear after a send (`""`). Pair with `value` to control it.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: run
props.description: Operation invoked by the component.

props.name: size
props.description: md: conversations and panes · lg: the landing hero (bigger send circle).

props.name: status
props.description: The conversation's status line (AiStatusStrip), the last row inside the composer.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
